extDescription.message: Look up words and check reading level in 7 languages with Gemini AI, plus on-device manga image translation.

commandTranslateImages.message: Translate the manga images on this page (keeps translating as you turn pages)

welcomeLead.message: Look up words and check difficulty while you read in another language, and translate images while you read manga. Works with English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, French and German.

welcomeStep1Images.message: Translate images: right-click an image and choose "Translate this image", or press $1 to translate a whole manga page automatically. Text recognition runs on your computer and images are never uploaded.

welcomeStep1Lookup.message: Look up words: click the LexiTechly icon at the top right of a page to turn on lookup mode. Hover over a word to highlight it, then click to see its translation.

welcomeStep1Analyze.message: Analyze a page: click the LexiTechly icon in the toolbar, then "Analyze current page" to estimate the article's level and list its vocabulary.

welcomeStep2Title.message: Add a Gemini API key for richer explanations (optional)

welcomeStep2Body.message: With an API key, each word also shows its level (CEFR, JLPT, TOPIK or HSK), part of speech, examples, synonyms and antonyms, and page analysis is done by AI. Analyzing the difficulty of pages that are not in English needs a key. Google offers a free tier, and getting a key costs nothing.

welcomeStep2How1.message: Go to Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account

welcomeStep2How2.message: Click "Get API key" to create a key

welcomeStep2How3.message: Paste the key below and click "Save and test"

welcomeKeyOk.message: The key works and has been saved.

welcomeKeyFailed.message: The key was saved, but the test did not succeed: $1

welcomeKeyAlreadySet.message: You have already set an API key. To replace it, paste a new one and save.

welcomeKeyPrivacy.message: The key is stored only in this browser on this computer. When you use AI features, page text is sent directly to Google's Gemini API.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Open any article in the language you are learning and try it. To change settings later, click the LexiTechly icon in the toolbar and open the Settings tab.

welcomeLangHint.message: With "Detect automatically", the language is worked out from each page. You can change this later in Settings.
